title: Streaming continuation candidate
summary: HTTPS v0.4.8 is a candidate built from exact Library v0.4.7 to provide bounded request-body and response-source streaming for WebDAV and other consumers; canonical promotion waits for exact-r13196 and live TLS qualification.
invariants: RxSock remains sole accepted-socket descriptor and network-I/O owner.
OpenSSL remains behind memory BIOs; the streaming seam does not pass sockets to OpenSSL.
Legacy buffered requests remain bounded by maxBodyBytes.
Claimed request bodies are delivered in bounded chunks after request-head/firewall preflight and are not accumulated into HttpRequest.body.
Streaming responses write headers first and feed bounded source chunks through existing TlsSession.writeAll backpressure.
A stream consumer owns the claimed request body and final response; it does not re-enter ordinary route/interceptor dispatch.
Do not promote v0.4.8 as accepted until exact ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 + Foreign Runtime v0.17.1 and live TLS forcing cases pass.

provenance.claim: CHATGPT continuation candidate; static PASS, runtime qualification pending.
